title: UniLM-Nav: A Unified Framework for Zero-Shot Last-Mile Navigation
summary: A last-mile navigation framework that selects a view, predicts a task-affordance point, and derives a geometry-aware manipulation-ready base pose.

mechanisms.name: View, affordance point, and manipulation-ready base pose
mechanisms.description: Jointly reasons over what view exposes the target, where the interaction should occur, and where the base should dock so the target is reachable.
mechanisms.limitations: Robot last-mile benchmarks and base-pose success do not establish blind-user guidance, phone localization, exact-instance identity, or safe navigation.
